par.description: Reduces the Pokémon's Speed by 50% and gives it a 25% chance of being fully paralyzed and unable to act each turn.

brn.description: Reduces Attack by 50% for physical moves and inflicts damage equal to 1/16 of maximum HP at the end of each turn.

slp.description: The Pokémon is asleep and unable to move for 1 to 3 turns.

psn.description: Inflicts damage equal to 1/8 of maximum HP at the end of each turn.

tox.description: Badly poisons the Pokémon, inflicting damage that increases by 1/16 of maximum HP at the end of each turn.

frz.description: The Pokémon is frozen solid and unable to move. It has a 20% chance to thaw out each turn.
